entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Canindeyú is a diocese of the Roman Catholic Church based in the city of Katueté, in the Ecclesiastical Province of Asunción in Paraguay. Roman Catholic Diocese of Canindeyú is a diocese of the Catholic Church in Americas, established in 2024-02-10. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
